sections.title: SWRN KS INTO ERN TX PANHANDLE/WRN OK
sections.text: SEVERAL CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL ENSEMBLES AND LATEST NAM/GFS SHOW A CLUSTER OF STORMS DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON OVER SWRN KS/OK PANHANDLE AND MOVING SEWD AS AN ORGANIZED MCS INTO THE ERN TX PANHANDLE/WRN OK AS A SLY LLJ STRENGTHENS THIS EVENING. EARLY AFTERNOON OBSERVATIONS SEEM TO SUPPORT THIS SCENARIO AS A RESERVOIR OF 50S DEWPOINTS EXISTS ACROSS WRN OK-ERN TX PANHANDLE INTO SWRN KS AHEAD AND TO THE E/SE OF A CLUSTER OF HIGH-BASED STORMS DEVELOPING OVER SWRN KS. A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT --OWING IN PART TO STRONG SURFACE HEATING-- COMBINED WITH A STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILE...WILL FAVOR STORM ORGANIZATION AS STORMS MATURE AND CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD INTO A MORE MOIST AIRMASS /PW 1.25 INCH/. SWATHS OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL SEEMINGLY BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THIS ACTIVITY BEFORE WEAKENING BY MID-LATE EVENING. ..SMITH.. 06/03/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1117 AM CDT MON JUN 03 2013/

sections.title: GREAT PLAINS
sections.text: UPPER LOW OVER CENTRAL MT IS FORECAST TO MOVE EWD THROUGH THE PERIOD REACHING WRN ND BY 04/12Z. FARTHER SOUTH...SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A WEAK VORTICITY MAX/SHORT WAVE TROUGH PROGRESSING EWD OVER SWRN KS. THIS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD AND WEAKEN FURTHER WITH TIME...WITH BROAD ANTICYCLONIC WLY FLOW REMAINING OVER THE CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...A COLD FRONT ARCING FROM LOW OVER ERN MT SWD INTO SERN WY AND NWRN CO WILL MOVE EWD AS THE PRIMARY SURFACE LOW DEVELOPS OVER ERN CO. A DRY LINE EXTENDING SWD FROM THE CO LOW INTO THE TX PANHANDLE WILL BECOME BETTER DEFINED AS STRONG HEATING/MIXING OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON. LOW LEVEL MOISTURE IS LIMITED OVER MUCH OF THE HIGH PLAINS WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS AOA 65F RESTRICTED TO SRN TX. NWD SPREAD OF MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE WITHIN A BAND OF SLY LOW LEVEL WINDS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WITH AN AXIS OF DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 40S TO MID 50S BECOMING ESTABLISHED EAST OF THE DRY LINE. VERY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE IN PLACE AND WITH STRONG DIABATIC HEATING EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON...THE AIR MASS WILL BECOME UNSTABLE /MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J PER KG/ WITH THE LARGEST CAPE FROM WRN KS SWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSO

sections.title: CENTRAL/ERN CAROLINAS INTO THE SRN DELMARVA PENINSULA
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY INDICATES A WEAK UPPER VORTICITY MAX ALONG A MINOR INFLECTION POINT IN THE MID/UPPER LEVEL MOISTURE DISCONTINUITY LOCATED OVER FAR WRN NC. MODEL GUIDANCE MOVES THIS FEATURE EWD ACROSS THE CAROLINAS AND SRN VA THIS AFTERNOON. DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS SYSTEM...VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS WIDESPREAD CLOUDS OVER COASTAL SC INTO ERN NC WITH SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS OVER THIS AREA. MORNING SATELLITE TRENDS HAVE SHOWN CLOUDS THINNING OVER MUCH OF SC INTO THE SRN PIEDMONT OF NC WHICH WILL PERMIT AREAS OF STRONGER HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION TO OCCUR WITH MLCAPE REACHING NEAR 1500 J/KG IN SOME AREAS. THERE IS POTENTIAL FOR NEW STORMS TO DEVELOP OVER CENTRAL PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS INTO SERN VA AS THE SHORT WAVE TROUGH MOVES EWD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. MODEST SWLY FLOW ALOFT OF 25-30 KT WILL SUPPORT MULTICELL STORM STRUCTURES WITH OCCASIONAL SHORT LINE SEGMENTS DEVELOPING. WEAK LAPSE RATES AND RELATIVELY HIGH FREEZING LEVELS SUGGEST THE HAIL THREAT WILL BE LIMITED. HOWEVER...HIGH VALUES OF PW COUPLED WITH DRY MID LEVEL AIR APPROACHING FROM THE WEST INDICATE A FEW STORMS MAY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LOCAL STRONG/SEVERE WIND GUSTS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE FROM CENTRAL SC INTO CENTRAL NC THIS AFTERNOON. ISOLATED STRONG...LOCALLY DAMAGING...WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT WITH STRONGER STORMS. A WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS HAVE STARTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL SC WHERE AMPLE HEATING HAS OCCURRED UNDER THINNING CLOUDS EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP FROM CENTRAL SC INTO CENTRAL NC THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WHERE WEAK DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED DUE TO AFOREMENTIONED HEATING/CLEARING. DEEP LAYER FLOW IS NOT PARTICULARLY STRONG AND BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 20-25 KTS WILL ALLOW FOR ONLY LOOSELY ORGANIZED CELLS. ADDITIONALLY...POOR LAPSE RATES WILL LIKELY LIMIT HAIL POTENTIAL. HOWEVER...PW VALUES APPROACHING 1.75 INCHES COULD AID IN WET DOWNBURST POTENTIAL IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. A WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS THE OK PANHANDLE...THE NRN-ERN TX PANHANDLE...SW KS AND WRN OK OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NECESSARY ACROSS THE MCD AREA OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A LOW IN SERN CO WHERE TEMPS ARE IN THE UPPER 90S F. HIGH-BASED THUNDERSTORMS ARE INITIATING ALONG THE THERMAL AXIS WHERE SFC-TEMP DEWPOINT SPREADS EXCEED 40 DEGREES F. AS THE CONVECTION MOVES EWD...THE DEVELOPING STORMS WILL ENCOUNTER SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER TO MID 50S F WHICH WILL ENABLE THE STORMS TO INTENSIFY WITH TIME THIS AFTERNOON. IN ADDITION...OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS THAT LOW TO MID-LEVEL FLOW STRENGTHENS WITH EWD EXTENT. 0-6 KM SHEAR VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 30 TO 35 KT RANGE ACROSS THE ERN TX AND OK PANHANDLES. THIS ALONG WITH STEEPENING LAPSE RATES SHOULD ENABLE THE STORMS TO HAVE A WIND DAMAGE THREAT AS DOWNDRAFTS ARE ENHANCED BY THE LARGE TEMP-DEWPOINT SPREADS. LARGE HAIL WILL ALSO BE INCREASINGLY LIKELY AS INSTABILITY INCREASES AND A POTENTIAL FOR SUPERCELLS DEVELOPS LATE THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG DRYLINE...COLD FRONT AND OUTFLOW FROM EXISTING CONVECTION OVER THIS CORRIDOR OF CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. AT LEAST TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURE IS POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH CLUSTERS AND LINES OF CONVECTION WITH DAMAGING-WIND POTENTIAL...HOWEVER THERMODYNAMIC FACTORS MAY LIMIT COVERAGE/DURATION. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE N OF WW 273 MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM OCCLUSION TRIPLE POINT IN CENTRAL SD...ACROSS CHERRY/GARDEN COUNTIES NEB...INTO NERN CO. FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE MOVING SWD OVER ERN CO AND SLOWLY SEWD ACROSS WRN/NRN NEB...MERGING THIS EVENING WITH SFC LOW ANALYZED JUST NNE GLD. SMALL-SCALE CIRCULATION ACCOMPANYING THAT LOW IS VERY WELL EVIDENT IN GLD REFLECTIVITY ANIMATIONS...AND SHORT BAND OF TSTMS HAS DEVELOPED OVER NEARBY PORTIONS RAWLINS/THOMAS COUNTIES KS. SFC ANALYSIS ALSO SHOWS MOIST AXIS EXTENDING FROM NEAR THAT CONVECTION SSEWD ACROSS CENTRAL KS...CHARACTERIZED BY NARROW CORRIDOR OF MID-UPPER 50S DEW POINTS. BRANCH OF THAT MOIST AXIS ALSO EXTENDS NWD FROM HYS-BBW-ICR...POTENTIALLY INTERACTING WITH COLD FRONT OVER S-CENTRAL SD AND PORTIONS NRN NEB SANDHILLS. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG FRONT...AND HAS OCCURRED IN DRY AIR OF SRN NEB PANHANDLE AND EXTREME SERN WY. LATTER ACTIVITY MAY CROSS FRONT AND DRYLINE AND INTENSIFY UPON REACHING HIGHER-PW AIR MASS. FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST NARROW CORRIDOR OF LITTLE OR NO MLCINH REMAINING IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF FRONT AND DRYLINE...BENEATH 1000-1500 J/KG MLCAPE. BUOYANCY DROPS OFF SHARPLY AND CINH INCREASES SUBSTANTIALLY WITH EWD EXTENT FROM THESE BOUNDARIES INTO SRN SD...NEB AND NRN KS. DIFLUENT FLOW ALOFT SW OF NRN PLAINS CYCLONE...40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES...AND SMALL POCKETS OF NEAR 150 J/KG EFFECTIVE SRH SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO ORGANIZATION OF ANY CONVECTION THAT CAN GROW UPSCALE ENOUGH TO SURVIVE STRONGER CAPPING FARTHER E...VIA STORM-SCALE PRESSURE PERTURBATIONS AND LIFT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL BAND OF TSTMS MAY POSE RISK FOR ADDITIONAL MRGL SVR HAIL AND/OR BRIEF TORNADO FOR ANOTHER 1-2 HOURS. THREAT APPEARS TOO LIMITED IN COVERAGE/DURATION FOR WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LOW-TOPPED BAND OF TSTMS HAS DEVELOPED OVER PORTIONS SLOPE/BOWMAN COUNTIES ND AND HARDING COUNTY SD...CORRESPONDING TO OCCLUDED FRONT EXTENDING SEWD FROM PRIMARY CYCLONE OVER MT. NARROW PLUME OF FAVORABLE INSOLATION/HEATING HAS LED TO DEVELOPMENT OF POCKET OF LOW-MID 60S F SFC TEMPS...JUXTAPOSED WITH DEW POINTS LOW 50S F...SUPPORTING 500-700 J/KG MLCAPE AND NEGLIGIBLE MLCINH IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING OCCLUDED FRONT. AT LEAST AS IMPORTANTLY...OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS BASED ON MODIFIED RR SOUNDINGS INDICATES PRONOUNCED MAX IN SFC VORTICITY ALONG THAT SEGMENT OF OCCLUDED FRONT FROM NRN HARDING COUNTY TO SRN SLOPE COUNTY...JUXTAPOSED WITH AROUND 100 J/KG OF 0-3 KM AGL CAPE. THIS INDICATES POTENTIAL FOR CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED VERTICAL STRETCHING OF VORTICITY ALONG CONVECTIVE ARC...MAINLY FOR ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS WHILE SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW PARCELS ARE MAXIMIZED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION HAS INCREASED SUBSTANTIALLY IN ORGANIZATION...INTENSITY AND COVERAGE DURING PAST HOUR...MAINLY OVER PORTIONS SWRN KS AND OK PANHANDLE BETWEEN DDC-GUY. THIS AREA OF CONVECTION MAY EVOLVE UPSCALE INTO FORWARD-PROPAGATING COMPLEX MOVING SEWD THEN SWD OVER PORTIONS ERN PANHANDLES AND WRN OK THROUGH EVENING...WITH DAMAGING WIND AND OCNL HAIL. MEANWHILE ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED DEVELOPMENT REMAINS CONDITIONALLY POSSIBLE ALONG TX PANHANDLE DRYLINE...WITH LARGE HAIL AND SPOTTY SVR GUSTS POSSIBLE IN ANY SUSTAINED TSTMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS SHOWS LOW INVOF GLD...NEAR INTERSECTION OF DRYLINE AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM NWRN KS CONVECTION MENTIONED IN MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 947. LEE TROUGHING REMAINS BACK IN ERN CO AND INTO WRN TX PANHANDLE. DRYLINE EXTENDS SSEWD NEAR LBL THEN SWD PAST PPA TO DONLEY COUNTY TX. LITTLE ADDITIONAL EWD MOTION OF DRYLINE IS ANTICIPATED BEFORE EVENING RETROGRESSION ACROSS PANHANDLES...LOCALLY MODULATED BY OUTFLOW FROM AFOREMENTIONED CONVECTION. THAT ACTIVITY PRODUCED HAIL UP TO 1.25 INCHES DIAMETER IN SEWARD COUNTY KS AT 2250Z. HOWEVER...PRIMARY SVR CONCERN IS EXPECTED TO TRANSITION TO WIND WITH TIME...AS AGGREGATED COLD POOL DEVELOPS. LBL AWOS MEASURED 65-KT GUST AT 2335Z...WHICH MAY INDICATE BEGINNING OF COLD-POOL DOMINANCE OF CONVECTIVE PROCESSES. THIS EVOLUTION SHOULD PRODUCE STRENGTHENING FORCED ASCENT OF AIR MASS INVOF MOIST AXIS...ANALYZED AT 2330Z INVOF OK BORDER WITH ERN TX PANHANDLE. W OF THAT MOIST AXIS AND ALONG/E OF DRYLINE...STG SFC HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO NARROW CORRIDOR OF MLCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG...BASED ON MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS. SEWD/SWD TURN OF TSTM CLUSTER IS FAVORED DUE TO COMBINATION OF 1. STRENGTHENING CINH AND WEAKENING BUOYANCY WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS NRN OK AND SRN KS...AND 2. NWLY ORIENTATION OF DEEP-SHEAR AND MEAN-WIND VECTORS...WITH EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES GENERALLY IN 40-50 KT RANGE OVER MOST OF AREA. ..EDWARDS.. 06/03/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ANOTHER WW MAY BE REQUIRED WITHIN THE HOUR TO COVER CONTINUING/PRIMARY SVR THREAT FROM MCS NOW TURNING SEWD ACROSS PORTIONS NERN TX PANHANDLE AND NWRN OK. COMPLEX PRODUCED 66-KT GUST AT GAG AT 227Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: UNCERTAINTY REMAINS AS TO HOW LONG THIS ACTIVITY WILL PERSIST...BUT ITS SUBSTANTIAL COLD POOL..AND CONTINUED POTENTIAL FOR FORCED ASCENT OF INCREASINGLY MOIST INFLOW-LAYER AIR SUGGEST THREAT WILL LAST BEYOND SCHEDULED 04Z WW EXPIRATION. 35-40 KT SLY LLJ...EVIDENT IN VWP/PROFILER DATA OVER WRN OK INTO SWRN KS...WILL AID WITH BOTH MOISTURE TRANSPORT INTO CONVECTIVE REGION AND STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW. STG MERIDIONAL GRADIENT IN BOTH CAPE AND CINH STILL IS EVIDENT OVER W-CENTRAL OK...ALONG AND E OF LLJ AXIS...AND SHOULD PERSIST ENOUGH SUCH THAT MCS EFFECTIVELY SHOULD TURN MORE SSEWD WITH TIME TOWARD HIGHER-THETAE AIR MASS OF SWRN OK AND EXTREME ERN TX PANHANDLE. PRESENCE OF NWLY TO NNWLY MEAN-WIND AND DEEP-SHEAR VECTORS OVER THIS REGION ALSO SUPPORT THAT SCENARIO. FARTHER W...TSTMS MOVING OUT OF SERN CO MAY OFFER MRGL SVR-WIND THREAT AS THEY MOVE THROUGH POCKET OF DEEP/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR WITH MRGLLY FAVORABLE BUOYANCY...UNTIL ENCOUNTERING MCS OUTFLOW OVER OK PANHANDLE AND EXTREME SWRN KS IN ANOTHER 1-2 HOURS. SEPARATE AREA OF CONVECTION OVER ERN NM HAS PRODUCED A FEW STG-SVR GUSTS IN DEEPLY MIXED AIR W OF DRYLINE. STATIC STABILITY SHOULD INCREASE WITH EWD EXTENT AND WITH TIME ACROSS ADJOINING SECTIONS OF PANHANDLE AND S PLAINS W OF DRYLINE...DECREASING POTENTIAL FOR SVR GUSTS GENERATED ALOFT TO REACH SFC. HOWEVER...SOME ADDITIONAL DAMAGING WIND IS POSSIBLE BEFORE THAT ACTIVITY DISSIPATES. ..EDWARDS.. 06/04/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SLIGHTLY ELEVATED TSTMS WILL PERSIST NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER STORMS IN NW OK HAVE WEAKENED WHILE MOVING INTO THE ZONE OF WEAKER BUOYANCY AND LARGER CONVECTIVE INHIBITION ACROSS CENTRAL OK. HOWEVER...NEW DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED OVER THE NE TX PANHANDLE...ABOVE THE OUTFLOW FROM THE WEAKENING LEAD STORMS. THIS CONVECTION WILL BE FED BY WAA OVER THE TOP OF THE OUTFLOW...ALONG THE AXIS OF GREATEST PW AND ON THE NOSE OF A 50 KT SSWLY LLJ. THE LLJ SHOULD SLOWLY VEER TO MORE SWLY WITH TIME EARLY THIS MORNING...AND THE CONVECTION WILL SPREAD SEWD TOWARD CENTRAL OK AND LIKELY WEAKEN BY THE SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIME OF THE WATCH. IN THE MEANTIME...THERE WILL CONTINUE TO BE A RISK FOR A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS GIVEN THE LARGE DCAPE ENVIRONMENT...AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL COULD ALSO OCCUR IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AS STORMS TRAVERSE THE INSTABILITY AXIS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MCS WILL LIKELY PERSIST AND MOVE SEWD ACROSS W CENTRAL/SW/CENTRAL OK THROUGH THE MORNING...WITH SOME RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. SINCE THE THREAT MAY PERSIST BEYOND THE SCHEDULED 09Z EXPIRATION...A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME...OR A NEW WATCH WILL NEED TO BE CONSIDERED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE STRONGEST CONVECTION IN TWO BANDS...ONE WNW-ESE ORIENTED TO THE NW OF OKC AND ANOTHER SW-NE ORIENTED OVER NW/W CENTRAL OK...WILL CONTINUE SPREADING SEWD THROUGH THE MORNING. THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE EXPECTED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO IN THE AREA FROM CSM TO JWG...WHERE THE TWO CONVECTIVE BANDS MERGE AND THE LOW-LEVEL INFLOW IS STRONGEST WITH THE LLJ JUST ABOVE THE SHALLOW COLD POOL FROM EARLIER STORMS. GIVEN THE CONTINUED FEED OF BUOYANCY JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE FROM NW TX /MUCAPE OF 1500-2000 J PER KG/...THE MCS WILL MAINTAIN SOME RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL...AS WELL AS OCCASIONAL STRONG-SEVERE SURFACE GUSTS IN THE LARGE DCAPE ENVIRONMENT. THE POSSIBILITY OF A LOCAL EXTENSION OR A NEW WATCH WILL BE DISCUSSED WITH THE TULSA NWS OFFICE SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND HAS COMMENCED WITH THE CONVECTION MOVING INTO SRN OK AND EXTREME NW TX...AND THE WEAKENING IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGH THE MORNING. WW MAY BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO SCHEDULED 14Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE MCS WITH A LEADING CONVECTIVE LINE AND TRAILING STRATIFORM RAINFALL CONTINUES TO MOVE SEWD AT 30 KT ACROSS S CENTRAL OK AS OF 1140Z. RECENT OK MESONET OBS HAVE SHOWN ONE RECENT GUST TO 58 MPH IN S CENTRAL OK /AT 11Z/...AND SOME MARGINAL DAMAGING WIND RISK WILL CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. MEANWHILE...THE MUCH MORE LINEAR STORM CONFIGURATION COMPARED TO EARLIER AND STORM MOTION INTO AN ENVIRONMENT WITH LESSER BUOYANCY AND LAPSE RATES BOTH SUGGEST THAT THE HAIL THREAT IS BECOMING QUITE MARGINAL. IT APPEARS THE MCS HAS ALREADY PASSED ITS PEAK INTENSITY...AND A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND IS EXPECTED THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE MORNING. ASSUMING THIS WEAKENING TREND CONTINUES AS EXPECTED...THE WW MAY BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO ITS SCHEDULED 14Z EXPIRATION.
